guard.title: Contact guards
guard.description: Tracking, contact and destination-freshness guards compose the task. Near the observed receiving surface, sustained load transfer with bilateral contact triggers opening at the measured hand pose, followed by withdrawal. Loss of contact/timeouts abort. Placement success is scored separately from simulator evidence.

ik.title: Bounded arm IK
ik.description: Joint/step-limited damped least squares and sampled tool clearance against known-shape source and destination supports. The recorded solver backend is identified in the evidence; this is local collision checking, not a full-body collision-free guarantee.

robot.title: G1 robot (sim)

destination.title: Destination estimate
destination.description: Stationary, axis-aligned 20 cm magenta marker detected from RGB-D. Visible-extent checks reject cropping; innovations above 12 mm after initialization are rejected. An exponential average smooths accepted measurements. Scene variants may move the tray before a run; this does not track a moving tray.

payload.title: Payload observer
payload.description: Rotates measured pad reactions with estimated robot orientation, gates updates on bilateral contact and slow hand motion, and low-pass filters a bounded vertical payload load. Mass is derived as load/g for diagnosis; no ground-truth payload mass enters.

feedforward.title: Jacobian feedforward
feedforward.description: Estimated payload load produces an arm torque correction through the hand Jacobian transpose. Compensation decays after release; no learned payload model is used.
